name: Latinia Mariani
source:
A famous writer in the World of Mtsyri. In addition to her writing career, Latinia is known as a philosopher and critic.
She suffers from memory disorder and heterochromia. She carries a small notebook, like a diary. According to the "Longevity" system, Latinia is a mtsyr of the highest rank.
